output.text: {"notes":["The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; forward_position and forward_velocity are world-frame quantities in m and m/s.","The requested readout time is t=2.0 s; observed states are supplied only through the 0.2 s observation cutoff.","A scheduled intervention runs on [0.472, 2.0) s: each axle uses zero-velocity braking with a maximum torque of 0.25 N·m, evaluated every 0.0001 s.","stopped_by_T requires absolute forward speed below 0.02 m/s and planar speed below 0.03 m/s continuously for 0.2 s, with the qualifying interval ending by T."]}
